svg.title: Trimmed history and full history, on the same 25 questions
svg.desc: Two slope charts for four systems, from the trimmed history of 10 sessions to the whole history of about 48. Accuracy: retrieval 100% to 96%, textual memory 96% to 92%, full context 92% to 84%, Mem0 84% to 84%; the order is the same in both runs. Cost per question: retrieval stays at $0.0016; full context goes from $0.0065 to $0.028; Mem0 from $0.040 to $0.18; textual memory from $0.022 to $0.28. One answer is 4 points.
svg.text: Trimmed history and full history, on the same 25 questions
Four systems, run again with the whole history (about 48 sessions instead of 10). Accuracy drops a little and keeps its
order; the cost of writing memory grows with the history.
USD to write, read and answer, log scale
On 25 questions one answer is 4 points, so every drop here is one or two answers. All four of full context's errors on the whole history gave the old
value, which was in its prompt next to the new one.
